places.title_kana: のあみやこじまくりあさっぷあんどしゅのーける
places.desc_en: Clear SUP + snorkel tours on Miyako; beach chosen for safety each day (may not be Yoshino).
places.desc_ja: 宮古島のクリアSUP＆シュノーケル。安全なビーチを前日決定（希望地と異なる場合あり）。
places.desc_ko: 미야코섬 클리어 SUP·스노클. 안전 해변을 전날 결정(희망지와 다를 수 있음).
places.hours_en: Tide / wind dependent; about 2 hours per segment; book via official LINE
places.hours_ja: 潮・風により変動・各約2時間・公式LINE予約
places.hours_ko: 조류·바람에 따라 변동 · 각 약 2시간 · 공식 LINE 예약
places.fee_en: Adult ¥11,000 (SUP ¥6,000 + snorkel ¥5,000) · elem-and-under ¥6,500 · single activity if only one runs
places.fee_ja: 大人11,000円（SUP6,000＋シュノーケル5,000）・小学生以下6,500円・1ツアーのみの場合は内訳料金
places.fee_ko: 성인 11,000엔(SUP 6,000+스노클 5,000) · 초등 이하 6,500엔 · 1투어만 시 내역 요금
places.parking_en: Meet at assigned beach (no facilities — confirm with guide)
places.parking_ja: 指定ビーチ現地集合（トイレ等なし・ガイド案内）

activity.duration_ja: 各ツアー集合〜解散約2時間
activity.includes_en: Guide · clear SUP and/or snorkel as booked
activity.includes_ja: ガイド・予約プランのクリアSUP／シュノーケル

places.title_ja: 渡嘉敷村ホエールウォッチング協会
places.title_kana: とかしきそんほえーるうぉっちんぐきょうかい
places.desc_en: Association whale watching from Tokashiki (Kerama). Short protection-minded season; morning sail ~2 h.
places.desc_ja: 渡嘉敷島の協会制ホエールウォッチング。保護のため短い開催期間・午前約2時間。
places.desc_ko: 도카시키섬 협회제 웨일 워칭. 보호를 위해 짧은 시즌·오전 약 2시간.
places.hours_en: 2026 season 24 Jan–8 Mar · 9:00 (staying guests) or 10:00 (with day-trippers) · ~2 h · book by 18:00 previous day
places.hours_ja: 2026年シーズン1/24〜3/8 · 宿泊者のみ9:00・日帰り含む10:00 · 約2時間 · 前日18:00まで予約
places.fee_en: ¥8,000 excl. tax per person (adult/child same) · cash settlement
places.fee_ja: お一人様8,000円（税別・大人子ども同額）・現金精算
places.parking_en: Island port / lodging pickup per association
places.parking_ja: 協会案内の港・宿送迎

activity.season_ja: 2026年：1月24日〜3月8日（保護のための開催期間）
activity.includes_en: Boat tour with association vessel · life jackets required
activity.includes_ja: 協会船でのウォッチング・ライフジャケット着用必須
activity.age_limit_en: Elementary-and-under must stay with an adult
activity.age_limit_ja: 小学生以下は必ず手を離さないこと

places.title_ja: 首里琉染 サンゴ染め体験
places.title_kana: しゅりゅうせんさんごぞめたいけん
places.desc_en: Hands-on coral-fossil dye workshop near Shuri Castle (unique to Shuri Ryusen). Bingata dyeing also offered (age 7+).
places.desc_ja: 首里城徒歩圏のサンゴ染め体験（首里琉染独自）。紅型染め体験も（7歳以上）。要予約。
places.desc_ko: 슈리성 도보권 산호 염색 체험(슈리 류센 독자). 빈가타도(7세 이상). 예약 필수.
places.fee_en: Coral dye adult ¥3,850 · child (3–elem) ¥3,300 (materials incl.) · ~50 min · web booking
places.fee_ja: サンゴ染め大人3,850円・子ども（3歳〜小学生）3,300円（材料込）・約50分・WEB予約
places.fee_ko: 산호 염색 성인 3,850엔 · 어린이(3세~초등) 3,300엔(재료 포함) · 약 50분 · 웹 예약

activity.age_limit_en: Coral dye from age 3; bingata dyeing from age 7
activity.age_limit_ja: サンゴ染め3歳〜・紅型染め7歳以上
activity.includes_en: Materials (tenugui / tote / T-shirt options) · take home same day
activity.includes_ja: 材料（手ぬぐい・トート・Tシャツ等）・その場持ち帰り

places.desc_en: Northernmost tip of Okinawa Island — rocky headland and open sea toward Amami. The Cape Hedo tourism plaza has a terrace lookout, café and visitor info.
places.desc_ja: 沖縄本島最北端の岬。岩場と奄美方面の大海原。辺戸岬観光案内所には展望テラス、カフェ、案内窓口があります。
places.desc_ko: 오키나와 본섬 최북단 곶. 암반과 아마미 방향의 넓은 바다. 헤도곶 관광안내소에 전망 테라스·카페·안내 창구가 있습니다.
places.hours_en: Cape open anytime · visitor plaza terrace typically 10:00–16:45 · info desk 10:00–17:00 (confirm on the day)
places.hours_ja: 岬は随時・観光案内所展望テラス 目安10:00〜16:45・案内所10:00〜17:00（当日確認）
places.hours_ko: 곶은 상시 · 관광안내소 전망 테라스 대략 10:00~16:45 · 안내소 10:00~17:00(당일 확인)
places.fee_en: Free (open cape lookout; plaza shops separate)
places.fee_ja: 無料（岬の展望は自由・案内所内店舗は別）
places.fee_ko: 무료(곶 전망은 자유 · 안내소 내 상점은 별도)
places.parking_en: Free parking at the Cape Hedo tourism plaza (about 70 cars per local tourism guides)
places.parking_ja: 辺戸岬観光案内所の無料駐車場（観光案内で約70台）
places.parking_ko: 헤도곶 관광안내소 무료 주차장(관광 안내 약 70대)
places.source: hedomisaki-okinawa.com (Cape Hedo visitor plaza) · Kunigami Village Tourism Association

places.desc_en: West-coast cape in Onna with cliff paths and sea views toward the Blue Cave dive area. Popular sunset lookout facing the East China Sea.
places.desc_ja: 恩納村の西海岸の岬。断崖の遊歩道と青の洞窟ダイビングエリアを望む海の眺め。東シナ海に面した夕日スポットとしても知られます。
places.desc_ko: 온나촌 서해안 곶. 절벽 산책로와 푸른 동굴 다이빙 구역을 바라보는 바다 전망. 동중국해를 향한 일몰 명소로도 알려졌습니다.
places.fee_ja: 無料（岬の展望は自由）
places.parking_en: Paid / managed parking near the cape entrance (confirm on site)
places.parking_ja: 岬入口付近の管理駐車場（現地確認）
places.parking_ko: 곶 입구 근처 관리 주차장(현장 확인)
places.source: Onna Village Tourism Association (Go to ONNA) · OCVB

viewpoint.walk_time_en: Short walk from the cape car parks to the cliff lookouts
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 駐車場から断崖展望所まで短い徒歩

places.title_ja: ニライカナイ橋展望所
places.title_kana: にらいかないばしてんぼうしょ
places.desc_en: Roadside lookout over the Nirai Kanai Bridge and the Pacific coast of southern Okinawa Island.
places.desc_ja: ニライカナイ橋と本島南部の太平洋岸を望む道路沿いの展望所。
places.desc_ko: 니라이카나이 다리와 본섬 남부 태평양 연안을 바라보는 도로변 전망소.
places.fee_ja: 無料（道路沿いの展望所）
places.parking_en: Small free pull-off parking at the viewpoint
places.parking_ja: 展望所の無料駐車スペース
places.source: Nanjo City Tourism Association · Okinawa Prefecture road sightseeing

places.title_ja: 古宇利島展望所（古宇利大橋）
places.title_kana: こうりじまてんぼうしょ
places.desc_en: Lookouts toward Kouri Bridge and the emerald shallows between Nakijin and Kouri Island.
places.desc_ja: 今帰仁と古宇利島を結ぶ古宇利大橋と、エメラルドグリーンの浅瀬を望む展望スポット。
places.desc_ko: 나키진과 고우리섬을 잇는 고우리 대교와 에메랄드빛 얕은 바다를 바라보는 전망 스폿.
places.fee_ja: 無料（展望は自由）
places.parking_en: Free parking near island-side and mainland-side lookouts (spaces limited on busy days)
places.parking_ja: 島側・本島側の展望付近に無料駐車場（混雑時は少ない）
places.parking_ko: 섬쪽·본섬쪽 전망 근처 무료 주차장(혼잡 시 적음)

places.desc_en: Sharp peak on the Motobu Peninsula (about 452 m) with hiking trails and wide Yanbaru / East China Sea views from the ridge.
places.desc_ja: 本部半島の鋭い山（標高約452m）。登山道があり、尾根からはやんばると東シナ海の眺めが広がります。
places.desc_ko: 모토부 반도의 날카로운 산(해발 약 452m). 등산로가 있으며 능선에서 얀바루와 동중국해 전망이 펼쳐집니다.
places.fee_ja: 無料（登山道）
places.parking_en: Trailhead parking near Pref. Route 84 (spaces limited)
places.parking_ja: 県道84号付近の登山口駐車場（台数は限られる）
places.parking_ko: 현도 84호 근처 등산로 입구 주차장(대수 제한)
places.source: Nago City / Motobu area tourism · Okinawa Prefecture mountain guides

viewpoint.walk_time_en: Hike from the trailhead (allow well over an hour round-trip; check trail condition)
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 登山口から往復1時間超を目安（登山道の状況を確認）
viewpoint.walk_time_ko: 등산로 입구에서 왕복 1시간 이상 여유(등산로 상태 확인)

places.desc_en: Highest peak on Okinawa Island (about 503 m) inside Yanbaru National Park — forest ridge hiking with island-wide views on clear days.
places.desc_ja: 沖縄本島最高峰（標高約503m）。やんばる国立公園内の尾根歩きで、晴れた日は島全体の眺めがあります。
places.desc_ko: 오키나와 본섬 최고봉(해발 약 503m). 얀바루 국립공원 능선 하이킹으로, 맑은 날 섬 전체 전망이 있습니다.
places.fee_ja: 無料（国立公園の登山道）
places.parking_en: Trailhead parking along the forest road (confirm access; roads may close after storms)
places.parking_ja: 林道沿いの登山口駐車場（通行止めに注意）
places.parking_ko: 임도 변 등산로 입구 주차장(통행 제한 주의)
places.source: Ministry of the Environment Yanbaru National Park · Kunigami Village

viewpoint.walk_time_en: Forest hike from the trailhead (several hours round-trip; check park notices)
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 登山口から往復数時間の登山（公園の通行情報を確認）
viewpoint.walk_time_ko: 등산로 입구에서 왕복 수 시간 등산(공원 통행 정보 확인)

places.title_kana: たまとりざきてんぼうだい
places.desc_en: Red-tile lookout over the Hirakubo Peninsula ridgeline and the coral reefs of Ishigaki’s east coast. Free entry; managed as an Ishigaki City tourism facility.
places.desc_ja: 平久保半島の山並みと石垣島東海岸のサンゴ礁を望む赤瓦の展望台。入場無料。石垣市の観光施設として管理されています。
places.desc_ko: 히라쿠보 반도 산줄기와 이시가키섬 동해안 산호초를 바라보는 붉은 기와 전망대. 입장 무료. 이시가키시 관광 시설로 관리됩니다.
places.fee_ja: 入場・駐車場 無料
places.parking_en: Free parking (upper lot preferred; toilets at the mountain-side lot)
places.parking_ja: 無料駐車場（山側が便利・トイレあり）
places.source: Ishigaki City Silver Human Resources Center (designated manager) · ishigaki-navi.okinawa

viewpoint.walk_time_en: About 3–10 minutes from the upper car park along the path
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 上段駐車場から遊歩道で約3〜10分

places.title_kana: ひらくぼざきとうだい
places.desc_en: White lighthouse at the northern tip of Ishigaki’s Hirakubo Peninsula — cliff and open-ocean views where the East China Sea and Pacific meet.
places.desc_ja: 石垣島・平久保半島の最北端にある白い灯台。断崖と大海原の眺め。東シナ海と太平洋が出会う岬です。
places.desc_ko: 이시가키섬 히라쿠보 반도 최북단의 흰 등대. 절벽과 넓은 바다 전망. 동중국해와 태평양이 만나는 곶입니다.
places.fee_en: Free (grounds lookout; lighthouse interior hours may be limited)
places.fee_ja: 無料（園地の展望・灯台内部は参観時間が限られる場合あり）
places.fee_ko: 무료(원지 전망 · 등대 내부는 참관 시간이 제한될 수 있음)
places.parking_ja: 灯台付近の無料駐車場
places.source: Ishigaki City tourism facilities (Silver Center designated manager) · Japan Coast Guard / Tokokai lighthouse pages

places.title_kana: りゅうぐうじょうてんぼうだい
places.desc_en: Three-storey dragon-palace-shaped lookout on Kurima Island with views of Maehama Beach, Irabu and the emerald sea. Listed on Miyakojima City’s scenic spots page.
places.desc_ja: 来間島の高台にある竜宮城をかたどった3階建ての展望台。前浜ビーチや伊良部島、エメラルドグリーンの海を一望。宮古島市の景勝地案内に掲載。
places.desc_ko: 구리마섬 언덕의 용궁 모양 3층 전망대. 마에하마 비치·이라부섬·에메랄드빛 바다가 한눈에. 미야코지마시 경승지 안내에 게재.
places.fee_ja: 入場無料（見学自由）
places.parking_en: Free parking next to the observatory (toilets at the car park; spaces limited)
places.parking_ja: 展望台手前の無料駐車場（トイレあり・台数は限られる）
places.parking_ko: 전망대 앞 무료 주차장(화장실 있음·대수 제한)
places.source: Miyakojima City scenic spots page · Miyakojima Tourism Association

viewpoint.walk_time_en: Under 1 minute from the car park to the entrance
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 駐車場から入口まで1分未満

places.title_ja: 池間大橋展望（橋詰広場）
places.title_kana: いけまおおはしてんぼう
places.desc_en: Bridge-end plaza on the Ikema Island side of Ikema Bridge (1,425 m) with views back toward Miyako and the surrounding sea — on Miyakojima City’s scenic list.
places.desc_ja: 全長1,425mの池間大橋・池間島側の橋詰広場。宮古島側と周囲の海を望む。宮古島市の景勝地案内に掲載。
places.desc_ko: 전장 1,425m 이케마 대교의 이케마섬 쪽 교두 광장. 미야코섬 쪽과 주변 바다 전망. 미야코지마시 경승지 안내에 게재.
places.fee_ja: 無料（橋詰広場）
places.parking_en: Parking at the Ikema-side bridge-end plaza
places.parking_ja: 池間島側橋詰広場の駐車場

places.desc_en: Westernmost point of Japan on Yonaguni — cliff and open ocean lookout with a monument and lighthouse area.
places.desc_ja: 日本最西端の与那国島・西崎。断崖と大海原の展望。記念碑と灯台周辺の園地です。
places.desc_ko: 일본 최서단 요나구니섬 이리자키. 절벽과 넓은 바다 전망. 기념비와 등대 주변 원지입니다.
places.fee_ja: 無料（岬の園地）

places.desc_en: Eastern tip of Yonaguni with cliff pastures and sunrise views over the Pacific.
places.desc_ja: 与那国島の東端。断崖の草原と太平洋の日の出の眺め。
places.desc_ko: 요나구니섬 동쪽 끝. 절벽 초원과 태평양 일출 전망.
places.fee_ja: 無料（岬の園地）

places.desc_en: Dramatic cliff lookout on Kumejima’s east coast — sea and cliff views from the banta (cliff) edge.
places.desc_ja: 久米島東海岸の断崖（バンタ）展望地。海と断崖の眺め。
places.desc_ko: 구메지마 동해안 절벽(반타) 전망지. 바다와 절벽 전망.
places.fee_ja: 無料（断崖の展望）
places.parking_en: Small free parking near the lookout
places.parking_ja: 展望所付近の無料駐車場

places.title_kana: たかつきやまてんぼうだい
places.desc_en: Hill observatory on Zamami Island with views over the Kerama islands and surrounding sea.
places.desc_ja: 座間味島の高台展望台。慶良間の島々と海を一望。
places.desc_ko: 자마미섬 언덕 전망대. 게라마 제도의 섬들과 바다가 한눈에.
places.fee_ja: 無料（村の展望台）
places.parking_en: Small parking / scooter space near the observatory road
places.parking_ja: 展望台への道沿いの駐車スペース

places.title_kana: とかしきじまてんぼうだい
places.desc_en: Hill lookout on Tokashiki Island over Kerama seas and neighbouring islands.
places.desc_ja: 渡嘉敷島の高台展望。慶良間の海と島々を望む。
places.desc_ko: 도카시키섬 언덕 전망. 게라마 바다와 섬들을 바라봅니다.
places.fee_ja: 無料（村の展望台）

places.title_kana: まきやまてんぼうだい
places.desc_en: White, bird-shaped lookout on Irabu Island’s high ground with views over Miyako, Ikema, Kurima, and Irabu Bridge. Free; parking and toilets on site (Miyako Island Tourism Association).
places.desc_ja: 伊良部島の高台にあるサシバをかたどった白い展望台。宮古本島・池間島・来間島と伊良部大橋を一望。無料。駐車場・トイレあり（宮古島観光協会）。
places.desc_ko: 이라부섬 고지의 새 모양 흰 전망대. 미야코 본섬·이케마·구리마와 이라부 대교를 한눈에. 무료. 주차장·화장실 있음(미야코섬 관광협회).
places.fee_ja: 入場・駐車場 無料
places.parking_en: Free parking near the observatory (short walk up)
places.parking_ja: 展望台近くの無料駐車場（短い上り徒歩）
places.parking_ko: 전망대 근처 무료 주차장(짧은 오르막 도보)

viewpoint.walk_time_en: A few minutes from the car park to the deck
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 駐車場から展望台まで数分

places.desc_en: Miyako’s northwestern tip lookout toward Ikema Bridge, Ikema Island, and Irabu — listed on Miyakojima City’s scenic spots page. Free; parking, toilets, and vending (Miyako Island Tourism Association).
places.desc_ja: 宮古本島の北西端。池間大橋・池間島・伊良部方面を望む景勝地（宮古島市景勝地ページ掲載）。無料。駐車場・トイレ・自販機あり（宮古島観光協会）。
places.desc_ko: 미야코 본섬 북서쪽 끝. 이케마 대교·이케마섬·이라부 방면 전망(미야코지마시 경승지 페이지). 무료. 주차장·화장실·자판기 있음(미야코섬 관광협회).
places.fee_ja: 入場・駐車場 無料
places.parking_en: Free parking at the cape (toilets and vending nearby)
places.parking_ja: 岬の無料駐車場（トイレ・自販機あり）
places.source: Miyakojima City · Miyako Island Tourism Association

places.title_ja: 伊江島タッチュー（城山）
places.title_kana: いえじまたっちゅー（ぐすくやま）
places.desc_en: Ie Island’s 172 m cone (officially Gusukuyama) with a summit lookout over the island. Always open to visitors per Ie Island Tourism Association; hiking stairs from the south trailhead.
places.desc_ja: 標高172mの伊江島のシンボル岩山（正式名称：城山）。頂上展望から島を一望。伊江島観光協会によれば常時観覧可能。南登山口から階段の登山。
places.desc_ko: 해발 172m 이에섬의 상징 바위산(정식명: 구스쿠야마). 정상 전망대에서 섬을 한눈에. 이에섬 관광협회에 따르면 상시 관람 가능. 남쪽 등산로 계단 이용.
places.fee_ja: 無料（登山道）
places.parking_en: Trailhead parking near the south climb (village / tourism association guidance)
places.parking_ja: 南登山口付近の駐車場（村・観光協会案内）
places.parking_ko: 남쪽 등산로 입구 근처 주차장(마을·관광협회 안내)
places.source: Ie Island Tourism Association · Ie Village

viewpoint.walk_time_en: About 20 minutes up / 15 minutes down on the south stair trail (tourism materials)
viewpoint.walk_time_ja: 南登山口から上り約20分・下り約15分（観光案内）
viewpoint.walk_time_ko: 남쪽 등산로 기준 오르막 약 20분·내리막 약 15분(관광 안내)
